stats_description: Statistics include the frequency count of three categories: (1) seafarers visiting the Mission Centre; (2) volunteer and staff visits to ships; and, (3) seafarers provided with transport to and from the port and desired destination in Halifax and Dartmouth. Data are presented in actual counts and tables, showcasing monthly and annual comparisons.

story_subtitle: Through our publications, we keep seafarers, supporters, and maritime communities informed, advocated for, and connected.
card_1_desc: Our newsletters share real stories from seafarers, highlighting their unique experiences, daily challenges, and the essential support they receive at our Halifax Mission.
card_2_desc: Through happiness surveys, statistics, and deeply researched reports, we continuously track seafarer wellbeing and strongly advocate for better conditions at sea.
cta_box_desc: Our publications provide invaluable insights into the daily lives of seafarers and the vital, life-saving work being done to support them in ports around the globe.
